test_overview: Evaluated the SRM regression test plan (79 pts full). Environment: app at http://localhost:8000 (React SPA + FastAPI). Steps 1 and 2 passed fully. Step 3 (test_create_pr_and_kanban_flow) FATAL FAILED: creating the purchase request per the test plan (Title='Regression Test PR', Category='Regression Test Materials', Priority='High', items 'Test Component Alpha-1' x50 and 'Test Component Beta-2' x100) produced a 422 Unprocessable Entity error with an unfriendly '[object Object]' alert, and no PR was created. The cause is the New Purchase Request form submitting deadline:'' (empty string) because the optional date input is left blank; the backend PurchaseRequestCreate schema (deadline: Optional[date]) rejects empty-string dates, so PR creation always fails when deadline is empty. A human QA cannot create a PR without a deadline, so this blocks the test plan's mandatory action and is fatal. Consequently the PR/auto-RFQ cascade could not proceed and evaluation stopped at step 3; remaining steps 4 through 14 were not executed (0 points each). Score: 13/79.

test_buyer_role_restrictions (5/5): Fresh buyer context login OK; buyer sees only Dashboard/Purchase Requests/Suppliers/RFQs/Orders and NOT Users/Categories/Stages; direct access to /users, /categories, /stages redirected to /dashboard with no admin content rendered (blocked).

test_create_pr_and_kanban_flow (0/6) FATAL FAILURE: Filling the New Purchase Request form exactly as the test plan specifies and clicking Save returned 422 Unprocessable Entity with an '[object Object]' alert; no PR created (kanban stage counts stayed 0, modal stayed open). Root cause: form submits empty-string deadline which the backend rejects, so a PR without a deadline cannot be created. Fatal - evaluation stopped; downstream steps could not run.
